svg.aria-label: Mechanical layout: a reservoir tank with lid and float level sensor feeds a solenoid valve and flexible hose into the top head of a vertical guide column. A sliding collar strokes up and down the column between two end positions. The column stands on a base housing that holds the motor and electronics and has an outlet port. Detail A enlarges the head, seal and column top.
svg.title: Fig. 1 – System layout
svg.text: Fig. 1 — Reservoir, feed line and sliding-collar column, redrawn from the concept sketch. Not to scale.
